audience.programmeDescription: Classics at Radboud studies ancient Greek and Latin languages, literature and culture. Students read and translate original texts and study ancient history, archaeology and literary research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related courses in Greek archaeology, ancient democracy, mythology, rhetoric and philosophy. These are valuable connections, but the available courses do not support a complete programme centred on Greek and Latin language and original-text study. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The 180-EC programme comprises 120 EC of required study, 30 EC of restricted Arts minors and 30 EC of open study. The pathway shown assumes school-level Greek and Latin. Where needed, language intensification replaces a first texts course. Mentorship, academic Dutch assessment and the thesis colloquium are also required zero-credit activities.

componentNotes.y2-minors: Two approved 15-EC Arts minors with fixed course packages.
componentNotes.y3-free-space: 30 EC of bachelor study outside the student’s own programme. Foreign study needs advance approval.
componentNotes.y3-thesis: Required 10-EC thesis after the two named literary and cultural methods courses; a zero-credit colloquium is also required.
componentNotes.y3-epigraphy: Requires Greek grammar 1 or 2 and Latin grammar 1 or 2.
